title: Plugin MCP server config (.mcp.json, mcp.json)
description: The mcpServers file a Claude Code plugin (.mcp.json) or a Cursor plugin (mcp.json) reads from its root. mcp.json is also the Agent Plugins 1.0 MCP config (GitHub Copilot CLI), so it may carry $schema set to https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/mcp.schema.json and "type": "stdio". Those fields are additive. Cursor still starts the server from command and interpolates ${userHome}; it does not expand ${HOME}. Claude Code's .mcp.json omits both fields and keeps ${HOME}. scripts/validate.js checks mcp.json against this schema and the vendored Agent Plugins MCP schema.

$schema.description: Present on mcp.json so the file satisfies Agent Plugins 1.0. Omitted from .mcp.json.
